item.title: Wall Street Reckoning Looms as Democrats Take Over Congress
item.description: For nearly two years, Wall Street firms and startups have enjoyed a sweeping deregulatory agenda from President Donald Trump that relaxed post-financial crisis rules and boosted nascent industries.

item.title: Tech Megacaps Power S&P 500 Higher as Election Uncertainty Eases
item.description: Technology megacaps rallied, leading the broader stock market higher, as Democrats swept to power in Congress and President Donald Trump said he would accept the midterm results, easing uncertainty and prompting investors to buy the recent dip.

item.title: Dollar Slides Toward Worst Day in Two Months After US Midterms
item.description: The dollar sank the most in two months as Democrats’ sweeping victory in the midterm elections fueled concern about potential political gridlock and raised the prospect of diminished spending on AI by US tech giants.

item.title: Stocks Rise, Democrats Clinch Control of Congress in Rebuke to President Trump
item.description: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern speak daily with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond. No other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day than "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Alcohol Stocks Jump as Blue Wave Boosts Industry Prospects
item.description: Investors are betting alcohol companies are among the winners of last night’s midterm election landslide on views a new Congress will push back on the Trump administration’s immigration and trade policies that dented booze businesses.
